ValidationRule.description: User should not be able to create or edit Override record
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula:
OR (
AND( $Permission.Skip_Validations_Permission = FALSE, ISPICKVAL(Key_Date_Category__c, "KYC"), Name = 'Due Date Override', (NOT(ISCHANGED(Active__c))) ),
AND( $Permission.Skip_Validations_Permission = FALSE, Name = 'Due Date Override', (NOT(ISCHANGED(Active__c))), ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(Key_Date_Category__c), "KYC") )
)
